general_disclaimer: AI-generated component identification and material composition are estimates and should not be treated as a certified recycling, hazardous-material, or commercial valuation assessment. Always observe OSHA/WEEE safety guidelines when handling electronic scrap.

battery.warning: DO NOT ATTEMPT MANUAL CELL TEARDOWN. Puncturing or bending lithium-ion batteries can trigger rapid exothermic thermal runaway with toxic fluoride and heavy metal gas emission.
personal_protective_equipment: Class D or specialized lithium battery fire extinguishing equipment nearby
mandatory_steps: Disconnect battery from motherboard before touching any other subassembly
Check battery pouch for thermal bloating, swelling, pungent chemical smell, or electrolyte leakage
Insulate terminals with non-conductive electrical tape immediately
Transfer immediately to a certified fire-safe battery collection drum

storage.hazard_type: Data Breach & Personally Identifiable Information Exposure
storage.warning: Unsanitized solid-state and hard drives may harbor sensitive personal, financial, or organizational credentials.
mandatory_steps: Perform NIST SP 800-88 Rev 1 Cryptographic Erase or ATA Secure Erase
Verify 100% completion of overwrite before channel transfer
If drive is non-functional or unreadable, perform physical mechanical degaussing/shredding (cross-cut ≤ 2mm)

glass_display.warning: Broken display glass poses deep laceration hazards. Older non-LED CCFL backlights contain trace mercury vapor.
mandatory_steps: Wear cut-resistant safety gloves (ANSI Level A4 or higher)
Inspect backlight type: if CCFL, handle unbroken into dedicated mercury-recovery stream

capacitors_power.warning: High-voltage electrolytic capacitors on power inverter or power delivery stages can hold charges even after unplugging.
mandatory_steps: Discharge bulk capacitors using an insulated 100-ohm 5W power resistor before touching solder joints
